reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01. The current product page has September 29 Framer rendering-release and optimization timestamps, which do not establish a substantive disclosure publication date. It still links the report dated March 31, 2024 at 18:00 BRT, reporting R$15,243,944.24 collateral against R$12,398,003.00 circulating and custody at an unnamed financial institution authorized by the Central Bank of Brazil. Neither the product page, linked report nor issuer whitepaper supplies a newer dated asset split, independent reconciliation, named custodian or account-level segregation terms. The preserved 100% BRL reserve row is historical, not a fresh composition; its bank-deposit categorization remains subject to interpretation because the report names custody at a financial institution rather than enumerating instrument types. compositionAsOf remains 2024-03-31; no score-bearing unknown exposure or custody protections are improved.
